title: Maison De La Mer | Luxurious 30A Beach Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Maison de la Mer is a pet-friendly 30A retreat with a private saltwater pool, golf cart, bikes, Gulf views, and quick access to beach and Gulf Place dining.
description_expanded: Maison de la Mer Features: - 250 steps to the Spooky Lane Beach Access. Straight path all the way to the sand. Beach service available at this location. - 2-minute bike ride or LSV ride to the Ed Walline Regional Beach Access. Parking, restrooms, and ADA accessible beach entrance available at this nearby location. Beach service available at this location. - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, non-aggressive breeds only. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. Unauthorized pets will result in fines and possible eviction. - Private Saltwater Pool. Pool heating available for all reservations October to April for an additional fee - Fenced-in and landscaped backyard with fire pit, seating set, and green space for the pup - Covered Outdoor Lounge with summer kitchen, fireplace, TV, and outdoor dining for 8 - Access to a 6-Seater LSV (golf cart). Must sign a waiver and be at least 21 years old licensed/insured driver - Access to 5 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape for your adventures - 2-minute bike ride or LSV ride to shopping, dining, live music, and entertainment at Gulf Place. Enjoy local favorites including Shunk Gulley, The Perfect Pig, and Growler Garage - 3.6 miles to Topsail Hill Preserve State Park, a wildlife viewing and hiking paradise with over 15 miles of trails. Guided kayak and paddle board tours available. The park also features a Geocaching course, summer camps, and the park is pet friendly (restrictions may apply). - Gulf Views from 2nd and 3rd Floor Front Balconies - Huge TV with Sonos bar in both the 2nd floor living room and the outdoor pool area - Gourmet Kitchen with high-end stainless-steel appliances including a walk-in pantry, wine fridge, Keurig, and drip coffee maker - Dining table with seating for 8-10 plus adjacent breakfast bar seating for 4 - WIFI throughout home with streaming TV available. Sign into your favorite services for movie night! - Laundry closet with washer and dryer on 1st floor - Workspace with desk and chair in 3rd floor King suite - Outdoor shower next to pool - Parking for 4 vehicles in the driveway (garage access not available for guests) - Concierge services including grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, catered beach bonfires and beach service at the Spooky Lane or Ed Walline Beach Access, and boat charters - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee This majestic beach home with meticulous details and finishes was custom built by the highly sought out, marquis builders - Cogent Building Group - for the distinct purpose to entertain and experience living one's best life on 30a. Professionally decorated with top-of-the-line furniture. This tri-level gem boasts an outdoor oasis with everything you could want for entertaining or just spending time with family. The gorgeous, heated saltwater pool, outdoor shower and lovely landscape creates an outdoor oasis that is perfect for entertaining or escaping. Cozy up on a pillow soft (yet durable) outdoor sofa, while watching tv and warming by the gas fireplace while you grill and chill in the perfectly designed summer kitchen. The beach access is only steps away at the Spooky Lane Beach Access. Maison de la Mer is also a short walk to the Ed Walline public beach access, Gulf Place and all the shops, art galleries, world class restaurants and art and music festivals that 30A has to offer. Shunk Gulley, voted "Perfect in Walton County" for 2024, is a 2-minute bike ride away. And don't forget about Growler Garage, with over 40 beers on tap. Only a 5-minute stroll from the home, and perfect for listening to live music at Happy Hour. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
